native-debug.parameter_rule: record exact configure, compile, and link argv; sanitizer flags must appear in compile and link steps

native-release.parameter_rule: hash unstripped and stripped outputs separately and record the strip tool identity

wasm-debug.parameter_rule: resolve initial memory, maximum memory, and pthread pool from the accepted manifest and record the exact tokenized argv

wasm-release.parameter_rule: resolve initial memory, maximum memory, and pthread pool from the accepted manifest and record the exact tokenized argv

browser-host-fuzz.parameter_rule: use a repository-owned deterministic seeded generator and runtime schemas; introduce no unpinned property-testing dependency

native-c-boundary-fuzz.parameter_rule: record corpus, timeout, memory, run-count, and worker parameters before execution

wasm-boundary-replay.parameter_rule: replay the identical content-addressed corpus; record SAFE_HEAP and sanitizer support-probe dispositions rather than silently changing the profile

profiles.purpose: matching optimized semantic and performance baseline
assertion, import/export, and supported sanitizer run
TypeScript manifest, Worker-message, lifecycle-state, and frame decoder generative testing
required_features: runtime schemas rather than TypeScript types alone

profiles.purpose: loader, release-member, BEAM-admission, and byte-ABI boundary fuzzing under native instrumentation
required_features: same-input identity for later browser replay

profiles.purpose: replay the shared boundary corpus and every minimized native failure through Wasm and browser host boundaries
required_features: browser crash and console artifact retention

unsupported_combination_rule: retain the toolchain probe and mark unsupported with reason; never omit a requested sanitizer or fuzz target silently and never treat another profile as equivalent

seed_and_coverage.seed_identity: sha256 per input plus ordered corpus manifest digest
seed_and_coverage.retention: content-addressed research/assets path linked from the execution journal

failure_minimization.orphan_rule: a crash without a retained reproducer and owner fails evidence handoff

sbom.format: SPDX JSON with an explicit reviewed specification version
required_fields: license concluded or explicit NOASSERTION with reason
attestation signer or explicit unsigned state

reproducibility.rule: perform an independently invoked rebuild from the recorded inputs, compare every output digest, and retain any differing bytes and explained nondeterministic fields
